answer: Each agent must stake a bond that vests only after three independent peers verify its work, so even a sparrow among a flock of fake identities pays the full price of a real one. A single honest signal, a completed attested task, unlocks the bond, while failed or duplicated work forfeits it. The cost stays flat for one agent but multiplies for a farm, and every forfeiture sends a ripple through the attacker's budget: a hundred Sybils need a hundred bonds and a hundred verified tasks, so cloning stops paying before it starts.
